messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE & SUBJECT TO CONTRACT — proposed terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Rashid,

We act for Calverton Industries Limited. Please find attached a letter setting out, on a without-prejudice basis and as a protected conversation under s.111A ERA 1996, proposed terms for an agreed exit. We strongly recommend you take independent legal advice; the Company will contribute towards your reasonable legal fees.

Yours sincerely,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

--

T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Mr Gallagher,

I've received your letter. I've instructed Birchall Stone to advise me. I think the offer significantly undervalues my claims, particularly the discrimination element, but I'm willing to engage. My solicitor Deepa Kovac will be in touch.

Imran Rashid
